title: Examiner Notes on Early Days Carried by Paper-Claim Fills — Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit
content:
**Rule.** Under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, early days carried by a paper-claim fill reduce the vacation supply, because a fill bought outside the network never passed the refill-too-soon edit.

- The carried early days are the days of the member's most recent paid network claim for the drug not yet run out on the date of service of a later approved paper claim for the drug, counted only when that paper claim falls within the network's accumulation window of today.
- When the carried early days exceed the network's accumulation limit, all of them are taken off.
- When they exceed 7 days but not that limit, the carried early days beyond 7 are taken off.
- Otherwise nothing is taken off.

## Figures by network

| Network | Accumulation limit (days) | Accumulation window (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Performance Network | 7 | 180 |
| Northbridge Essential Network | 7 | 180 |
| Northbridge National Network | 10 | 180 |
| Northbridge Preferred Savings Network | 10 | 180 |
| Northbridge Retail90 Network | 15 | 180 |
| Northbridge Open Choice Network | 15 | 180 |

## Examiner questions

**Which paper claim is used?** The most recent approved paper claim for the drug, and only when its date of service is later than the date of service of the most recent paid network claim for the drug.

**How are the carried days counted?** The network claim's days supply less the calendar days from its date of service to the paper claim's date of service, never below zero.

**What does "within the accumulation window of today" mean?** The calendar days from the paper claim's date of service to today are no more than 180.

**Northbridge National Network, 9 carried days?** 9 exceeds 7 but not 10, so 2 days are taken off.

**Same network, 12 carried days?** 12 exceeds 10, so all 12 are taken off.

**Northbridge Essential Network, 9 carried days?** 9 exceeds the limit of 7, so all 9 are taken off. On this network, 7 or fewer carried days take nothing off.

**Northbridge Retail90 Network, 7 carried days?** 7 does not exceed 7: nothing is taken off.

**Paper claim dated 200 days ago?** It falls outside the 180-day window, so no early days are carried.
